thread:
maya: Hey team, I'm taking the 18:00-02:00 oncall tonight. Quick preflight - can folks confirm they can access VPN, PagerDuty, and jumpbox? I ran the checklist but want a quick sanity check.

julian: I'm good for VPN and PD. Pulled latest runbook at https://notion.redwood.com/s/Oncall-Runbook (check "night shift" section). :thumbsup:

sam: VPN connects, but my SSH key expired on the jumpbox. Fixed it: generated new key + uploaded to vault. Command I ran:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall
vault write secret/oncall/keys maya_pub="$(cat ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall.pub)"
```

maya: Thanks — can you paste the vault path? I'll test.

sam: path is secret/oncall/keys (kv-v2). To test access: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_oncall ubuntu@jump.redwood.internal` should land on jump and `sudo -l` shows oncall group.

infra-bot: NOTICE: Agent token rotation scheduled at 23:30 UTC; if you hit auth errors after that, re-run `vault login` and fetch new token with `vault kv get -format=json secret/oncall/tokens | jq -r .data.value`

julian: PagerDuty: you're on schedule for rotation. Test page by triggering test alert in PD UI -> Services -> Redwood Prod -> "Trigger test incident". Don't actually ack unless you're testing.

oncall-bot: Reminder: confirm MFA TOTP via `sudo -i` on jumpbox requires one-time code. If you don't have it, create emergency code in 2FA settings: https://auth.redwood.com/mfa

maya: Done — VPN ✅, jumpbox ✅ (sudo works), PagerDuty test fired and I received page. Two notes: keep an eye on model-serving pool CPU around 23:00 (batch job ramp), and the nightly checkpoint job can cause transient 503s for ~30s. Adding extra watch in Grafana -> Dashboards -> "runtime/serving" and alert set to 5% error rate per minute.

sam: Got it. I'll keep an eye on the checkpoint window. Good luck tonight — ping me if anything weird. :rocket:

julian: Thanks, maya. Assigning handoff to you in the schedule. :white_check_mark:
